review.eventDescription: One TripAdvisor restaurant or attraction review: 1-5 bubbles, food/service/value/atmosphere sub-ratings, tips, owner's reply (row keys review_id, rating, title, text, sub_ratings, language, original_language, visit_date, trip_type, tips, reviewer_name, photos, helpful_votes, response): $5 per 1,000 reviews, once per language site. Not charged: the location row (rating, ranking, cuisine, hours, address, phone), reviews removed by maxRating, tripTypes, sinceDate, requireText or includeTranslated, locations with no reviews, unknown ids, hotel ids (wrong_type), duplicate targets, failed pages and status rows. No start fee; proxy and compute are included in the event price. The run stops at the maximum cost per run you set when starting it (Apify run option maxTotalChargeUsd), never above it.
